title: MPEG TS improvements for PES and PMT handling
description:
These commits make the following improvements to the MPEG TS (ISO/IEC 13818-1 | Rec. ITU-T H.222.0) protocol:
1) It adds strings/text for all defines stream types
2) It stops the "length == 0" warning from appearing for a video content PES that contains either JPEG XS or JPEG 2000 video.
3) It adds support for the ISO defined extension descriptor (tag == 0x3F). This extension descriptor differs from the ETSI-defined extension descriptor that was already implemented (tag == 0x7F).

notes.body: This is a low-effort contribution for now. If accepted and found useful, I might spend more time to implement additional functionality for MPEG TS. Feedback is welcome.

I don't understand why the CLang + Code Checks failed. Any help?

`packet-mpeg-pes.c` is automatically generated from the files in `epan/dissectors/asn1/mpeg-pes`. In order to update it you need to update the appropriate file (`packet-mpeg-pes-template.c` in this case) and build the "asn1" target.

The "Clang + Code Checks" job builds the asn1 target locally and errors out if there are any diffs in the code. It should probably be more descriptive about what's going on.
Thank you for explaining. I understand now, and I also notice the header of packet-mpeg-pes.c stating it is generated and "do not modify". Duh. I will make the necessary changes.
